title: protect_response no-PIV path missing active check - fresh contexts bypass registration
description:
In the protect_response method (lib.rs:996-1011), the no-PIV path (include_piv=false) does not check self.active. Fresh (unregistered) contexts with allow_no_piv_response=true can protect responses without going through register_fresh, bypassing the invariant that only active contexts may encrypt.

This is visible in the failing test 'fresh_context_activates_only_after_atomic_registration' which expects OscoreError::InvalidParam from an unregistered context but now gets Ok.

Fix: Add an active check in the no-PIV path, e.g. if !self.active { return Err(OscoreError::InvalidParam); }

Additionally, the test 'response_without_piv_requires_requester_identity' fails with a similar issue - no-PIV responses succeed without proper requester identity validation.
